The '''Pizilis system''' was located in the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]], a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Dauntless Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected it to the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rorgam]] while the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Nightroad/Legends|Nightroad]] linked the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] to the worlds of [[Mytaranor]] and [[Terr'skiar]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Pizilis system contained a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type planet named [[Pizilis]] that was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by several [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. The moons had many small settlements on them that were supported by corporations out of the worlds of [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]], [[Randon/Legends|Randon]] and Rorgam.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pizilis system was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it within grid square P-10.<ref name="TEA" />
